title: Medical College of Wisconsin gets $50M gift to advance precision medicine
The 36 Award Winner: Building a Public Health Response to Antisemitism
body: Myrieme Churchill, Executive Director of Parents for Peace (P4P), has been named an inaugural recipient of The 36 Award, honoring a decade of work building what may be the first confidential intervention program in the world focused specifically on antisemitism.
